content.short: Analyzes MEV performance of validators on Ethereum and MEV-boosts.
content.description: The Dune MEV Dashboard is a focused analytics tool for monitoring MEV-boosts that follow recognizable patterns, such as a block’s final transaction moving ETH from the fee recipient to a validator address. It helps blockchain analysts and validator operators assess how effectively different validators are included on the Ethereum network, enabling evaluation of participation, timing, and impact on MEV and finality. Users can track validator inclusion rates, compare performance over time, and spot anomalies in MEV delivery to inform research and governance decisions.
